$comment: Source of truth for docs/global/payments-einvoicing.md (generated: npm run payments-einvoicing:write). EVERY value below is a starting hypothesis marked [VERIFY] until verification.status is "verified" with a primary source, a reviewer and a [COUNSEL] reviewer. Not legal advice.

rows.taxInvoiceRequirements: No federal VAT-style invoice format. Sales tax is shown per state/jurisdiction rules; some states require specific line items or exemption wording.

eInvoicing.note: No general B2B e-invoicing mandate is assumed. Federal procurement invoicing rules need checking.

rows.taxInvoiceRequirements: GST/HST registrants must show the registration number and tax amounts above CRA thresholds; Quebec adds a QST number and QST line.

eInvoicing.note: No general B2B e-invoicing mandate is assumed.

rows.taxInvoiceRequirements: VAT invoice: supplier VAT number, tax point, rate and amount per rate, customer details above HMRC simplified-invoice limits.

eInvoicing.note: Government plans for e-invoicing have been published; the legal status and dates must be checked.

rows.taxInvoiceRequirements: Tax invoice for taxable supplies above the ATO threshold: words "tax invoice", ABN, date, GST amount or a statement that the total includes GST.

eInvoicing.note: Peppol e-invoicing exists; whether it is mandatory for any flow must be checked.

rows.taxInvoiceRequirements: EU VAT Directive invoice content (supplier and customer identity, VAT ids, date, number, description, rate and amount per rate, reverse-charge wording where used) plus national additions.

eInvoicing.note: B2G receipt by contracting authorities follows the EU e-invoicing directive; B2B status for this country is not yet checked.
